rules.acceptable_fallback: Net 45 days is acceptable without edits for Enterprise tier.
rules.escalation_trigger: Net 90 days or longer requires CFO approval; do not auto-edit, escalate.

rules.standard_position: Capped at 12 months of fees paid preceding the claim.
rules.acceptable_fallback: 24 months of fees paid is acceptable.
rules.escalation_trigger: Uncapped liability or nominal caps under $1,000 must be redlined to 12 months of fees paid.

rules.standard_position: Mutual indemnification capped at the Agreement's Limitation of Liability.
rules.acceptable_fallback: Uncapped IP infringement indemnity only if mutual and subject to standard exclusions.
rules.escalation_trigger: Broad, uncapped third-party indemnification with unlimited liability requires General Counsel sign-off; escalate immediately.

rules.standard_position: State of California, venue in San Francisco County.
rules.acceptable_fallback: State of Delaware or State of New York.
rules.escalation_trigger: Any other jurisdiction must be redlined to California / San Francisco.
